title: Satellite Images Reveal 44 New Scam Compounds in Myanmar
excerpt: An exclusive satellite imagery analysis reveals at least 44 new scam compounds have been built in Myanmar over the past six months, despite an official crackdown. The findings show a 200% increase in the footprint of these criminal enterprises, which exploit trafficked workers to conduct online fraud.
description: Satellite images reveal 44 new scam compounds in Myanmar despite official crackdown, showing 200% increase in criminal footprint exploiting trafficked workers.
